_readme: Walkabout shop settings. Prices are AUD cents, GST included. The page and the checkout both read this file, so a change here changes both. Rod 'stock' is how many rods we started with: the checkout takes off what Stripe says has sold. Shirt and shorts stock is NOT in this file: it is read from the Barefoot Merch Manifest Google Sheet (see stock_sheet).
closed_message: Founding rods open on Sunday 29 November.
_founding_readme: Founding prices end when founding_limit rods have sold OR at founding_ends (Darwin time), whichever comes first. The checkout switches to the full prices by itself. The countdown shows the live N of 100 Founding rods left line once fewer than founding_count_below are left (101 means it always shows). After Founding prices end, the same spot counts down to christmas_order_by (Darwin time), then shows nothing. That second countdown is display only: it never changes a price or stops an order.

checkout_notes._readme: The line buyers see beside the Pay button on the Stripe page, for orders with a rod in them. The first step whose 'until' time (Darwin) has not passed is used; 'after' is used once they all have. Plain words only, no links.

waitlist._readme: Deposit waitlist for the next batch. It only ever shows for a rod that has sold out, and only while enabled is true. prices are the next-batch prices a deposit locks in (AUD cents, GST included). deposit_pct is the share of that price paid up front. The same prices are written in words on the waitlist card on both Walkabout pages: change them there too.

stock_sheet._readme: Where shirt and shorts stock comes from: the Barefoot Merch Manifest Google Sheet. Under 'extras', each size names its line (the SKU) on the Stock tab, and the site sells that line's Available number. A paid website order also comes off straight away, and keeps coming off until its order ref (order_ref_prefix plus the last 6 characters of its Stripe id) is on the Orders tab with a Status on every one of its lines; from then on the Sheet's own numbers cover it. 'stock' is the block of the Stock tab that is read (the SKU and Available columns are found by their headings). 'order_refs' and 'order_status' are the Order ref and Status columns of the Orders tab. If a tab is renamed, or one of those headings is renamed or its column moved, the site stops selling shirts, shorts and Expedition Kits until these lines are corrected. Rods keep selling.
